Kit summary

Phantasm PipingBasic
Deals 180% ATK DMG to a single enemy and restores HP by 4% of Ronai's Max HP for all allies.
Melody of LifeActive
Grants 1 layer of [Heal] on all allies for 2 turns. Afterward, increases Turn Meter by 15% for all allies.
Dance in the BreezePassiveExclusive Lv.2 · Lv.3
When a battle starts, Ronai keeps the balance between her initial Effect Hit and Effect RES, increasing the lower one to the same as the higher one. She can gain Effect Hit or Effect RES up to 120% in this way. When Ronai survives, reduces the Direct DMG taken by allies with [Heal] by 10%; if the ally does not have [Consolidation] or effects considered as [Consolidation], reduces the Direct DMG taken by the ally by 24% instead. Only the skill with the strongest effect will take effect when there are multiple skills that can increase this attribute.
Legendary Fife Lv.2For every 1 layer of [Heal] granted by Ronai on any ally, grants this ally 5% Turn Meter immediately and self 1 layer of [Butterfly Dance] for 2 turns. Each [Butterfly Dance] increases self SPD by 5%, up to 8 layers.
Legendary Fife Lv.3At the beginning of each wave, Ronai grants 1 layer of [Heal] on all allies for 2 turns. Additionally, when Ronai survives, for every 1 stage of Direct DMG taken by any ally, if the ally's HP percentage is lower than 100%, restores this ally's HP by 2% of Ronai's Max HP; if this ally has [Heal], restores this ally's HP by 5% of Ronai's Max HP instead.
Dreamy Butterfly TornadoActiveExclusive Lv.1
Summons dreamy butterflies to attack all enemies, dealing 3 stages of 100% ATK [Poison] DMG each. When the attack ends, there is a 60% chance to inflict [Feebleness II] for 2 turns and a 60% chance to inflict [Hypnotize] for 1 turn.
Legendary Fife Lv.1Dreamy Butterfly Tornado: Each stage reduces all enemies' Turn Meters by 8%
